gates.description: Runs React Doctor and the runtime UI smoke, including temporary-entity cleanup proof and responsive screenshots.
gates.proofScope: Caller-command equivalent in the documented local development mode on Windows; the hosted Ubuntu production-mode negative canary remains tracked in #161. A restored local production-mode caller passes after #148.

observedFailure.command: MCK_REGRESSION_SERVER_MODE=dev MCK_REGRESSION_PORT=5392 MCK_SMOKE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5392 MCK_SMOKE_ARTIFACT_DIR=artifacts/recovery-217c312-20260826/runtime-negative-smoke npm run check:runtime-regressions
observedFailure.reason: An asserted owned fixture server on port 5392 returned a non-MCK page. The caller exited 1 with React Doctor green and runtime UI smoke red: Mission Queue timed out and cleanup could not prove the fixture's synthetic undefined entities absent. The owned PID 73616 was then stopped and port 5392 was proven released.
observedFailure.restoredPass: Against a fresh isolated Next 16.2.9 development server on the same port, the same caller command with the restored artifact directory exited 0: both checks passed, all 16 smoke assertions passed, and cleanup proved all 4 temporary entities absent. Owned PID 61452 was stopped and the port was proven released. After #148, the default local production-mode caller on port 5393 also exited 0 with 16/16 browser assertions, four screenshots, 4/4 entities absent, and a released port.

gates.description: Rejects credential-shaped values in Git history with redacted evidence.
gates.proofScope: Redacted local invocation matching the action's detect mode, exit code, report format, and Git-history scan; a deliberate hosted-action canary remains tracked in #161.

observedFailure.reason: After asserting a generated synthetic credential existed only in an ignored isolated Git history, the action-equivalent caller exited 2, reported exactly one generic-api-key finding in proof.env, and both log and SARIF readback contained REDACTED instead of the value.
observedFailure.restoredPass: The identical command against a separate clean isolated Git history scanned one commit, reported no leaks, wrote an empty SARIF result set, and exited 0. The owning repository never tracked the synthetic value.
